purpose: Distinguish a missing CPU model artifact from a missing submitted input artifact
injected_mechanism: Temporarily hide only the text-topic-v1 model artifact inside the local CPU worker, restart that worker to clear its model cache, and submit one new synthetic text job
control: After exact artifact restoration and worker restart, submit the same synthetic text through a new job and require success
confounder: A separate missing input artifact must continue to report missing_input; generic inference FileNotFoundError must not become a model-artifact claim
limits: The pre-repair prediction follows current source code and has not yet been observed in a live worker.
The post-repair rule is developed for this registered mechanism; its eventual run is an acceptance check, not held-out accuracy.
This local intervention must wait for zero outstanding CPU jobs and must restore the model bytes even if the test fails.
No GPU model, user video, remote environment or production worker is modified.
